built.heading: What we built. Why it works.
built.intro: Two thousand years of human reflection on the questions that matter, examined through modern research, made accessible through AI. All for one purpose: helping you see what you couldn't see alone.
built.easternBody:
For two thousand years, Eastern philosophical traditions have examined the questions humans keep asking — about decision, direction, and the patterns that shape a life.

Career. Love. Direction. Doubt.

These traditions weren't about fixed predictions. They were frameworks for thinking — refined over eighty generations of human experience.
built.modernBody:
What ancient observation noticed, modern research is beginning to measure.

Cognitive science on how we frame decisions. Spatial psychology on attention. Circadian biology on natural rhythm. Behavioral economics on cognitive bias.

The frameworks that worked for millennia, now examined through contemporary research.
built.aiBody:
We took the frameworks these traditions developed. We added what modern research has examined. We gave it to AI — to respond to your specific question, in your specific moment.

Not to replace your judgment. To return the conversation to you.

These tools are designed for self-reflection and personal exploration — not for predicting outcomes, diagnosing conditions, or providing professional advice.
built.closingHeading: This is what pojulife is for.
built.closingBody: The questions that matter, met with the depth they deserve — across two millennia of human reflection, the rigor of modern research, and the immediacy of AI.

how_it_works.subtitle: No una sola respuesta — un ciclo continuo de avance.

1.title: Presenting Your Dilemma
1.description: Share Your Current Dilemma. Present the specific challenge, confusion, or decision that is weighing on your mind right now.

2.title: Deep Collaborative Dialogue
2.description: Engage in Deep Dialogue. Interact through a reflective multi-turn conversation as POJU guides you to align the full context of your situation.

3.title: Trajectory Profiling
3.description: Dynamic Visual Trajectory Tracking. The system locks into your personal energetic blueprint, mapping and tracking your real-time state with custom metaphorical visual patterns.

4.title: Core Structural Analysis
4.description: Deep Core Structural Analysis. Leveraging the algorithmic matrix of the I Ching and Five Elements (Wu Xing), the system performs deep chronological calculation and systemic analysis, seamlessly cross-referencing your personal spatiotemporal blueprint with the full context of your real-world challenge.

5.description: Receive Your Synthesis Report & Guidance. Get a comprehensive breakthrough report containing deep behavioral analysis, strategic solutions, and actionable practical recommendations.

6.title: Evolutionary Tracking
6.description: Progress Tracking & Feedback Adaptation. As you put the strategies into practice, POJU tracks your evolutionary progress, standing ready to adjust and recalibrate based on your real-world feedback.

footer.title: 30-Day Single-Focus Sanctuary
footer.description: Real breakthroughs take time. For the specific challenge you present today, you unlock a dedicated 30-day coaching window. As your real-world situation unfolds or shifts, you can return to this dynamic dialogue at any time to log updates and refine your strategy. We are in this together, layer by layer.

on_the_cards.heading: Sobre las cartas.
paragraphs: Los cinco glyphs no son etiquetas de fortuna. No son "buenas cartas" o "malas cartas."
Cada uno es una lente — una forma de leer este momento particular, para esta pregunta particular, sostenida por esta persona particular.
El mismo glyph puede significar cosas completamente diferentes en días diferentes, para personas diferentes, sobre preguntas diferentes.
Lo que recibes no es un veredicto. Es una perspectiva — y una invitación a mirar con más cuidado.

home.use_case_family_desc: Entiende relaciones familiares difíciles — padre, hijo, hermano, suegros.

home.use_case_relationship_desc: ¿Tensión con alguien? Mira qué es estructural y qué es superficial.
home.use_case_friendship_desc: Por qué algunas amistades fluyen y otras se apagan — las cartas suelen tener la respuesta.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.body: Your first Match is free — no card required. We want you to experience the full report before you pay. After that, each complete reading is $4.99. One purchase, one report. No subscription. No auto-renewal.
pricing.price_unit: per complete reading · first Match free
features: Full personality profile analysis of both people
Energy structure & relational dynamics interaction map

home.faq_q1: ¿Y si no sé la hora de nacimiento de la otra persona?
home.faq_a1: Puedes hacer Match con hora aproximada — la precisión baja un poco pero el análisis central sigue siendo valioso. Usamos ventanas de 2 horas (horas chinas), así que incluso una estimación sirve.
home.faq_q2: ¿La otra persona tiene que saberlo o consentir?
home.faq_a2: Match es para tu comprensión. La otra persona no tiene que participar. No les contactamos, no compartimos sus datos ni revelamos que hiciste la lectura. Su carta queda solo en tu dispositivo.
home.faq_q3: ¿Puedo hacer más de dos personas a la vez?
home.faq_a3: Match se centra en dinámicas de dos personas — así la lectura sigue siendo profunda y clara. En situaciones complejas (p. ej. tú + pareja + padre), sugerimos Matches separados por relación.
home.faq_a4: POJU es una conversación profunda de 30 días sobre tu situación. Match es una lectura puntual de dos cartas sobre una relación concreta. Herramientas distintas — muchos usan ambas.
home.not_footer: Match offers perspectives, not predictions. What you do with them is entirely yours.
